items.description:
This tape has a Japanese tv broadcast of Amazing stories with several episodes and intermissions from a tv host. The tape was recorded in late 1989 or early 1990.
Episodes are as follows.
The amazing Falsworth.
The wedding ring.
Life on death row.
Ghost train.
